note: Four scheduled 5–10 PM events compared with each immediately preceding Thursday in the same area and hours.
limitations: The aggregate counts are a frozen 2026-07-26 snapshot; live datasets and event pages may later change.
The four preceding Thursdays are convenience controls, and the aggregates do not expose call-category or officer-initiated breakdowns.

series.query: SELECT date_trunc_ymd(requested_datetime) AS day, service_name, source, count(*) AS n WHERE requested_datetime >= '2025-09-01T00:00:00' AND requested_datetime < '2025-12-26T00:00:00' AND date_extract_dow(requested_datetime) = 4 AND date_extract_hh(requested_datetime) BETWEEN 17 AND 21 AND lat BETWEEN 37.7809 AND 37.7900 AND long BETWEEN -122.4137 AND -122.4023 GROUP BY day, service_name, source ORDER BY day, n DESC LIMIT 5000
series.countMethod: Sum n across every grouped row for each date.

series.query: SELECT date_trunc_ymd(received_datetime) AS day, call_type_final_desc, agency, onview_flag, count(*) AS n WHERE received_datetime >= '2025-09-01T00:00:00' AND received_datetime < '2025-12-26T00:00:00' AND date_extract_dow(received_datetime) = 4 AND date_extract_hh(received_datetime) BETWEEN 17 AND 21 AND within_circle(intersection_point, 37.78545, -122.4080, 500) GROUP BY day, call_type_final_desc, agency, onview_flag ORDER BY day, n DESC LIMIT 5000
series.countMethod: Sum n across every grouped row for each date.
